activity.role: Leader of the Socialist Unity Party of Germany
activity.notes: Erich Honecker succeeded Walter Ulbricht as the top SED leader in 1971 and remained the GDR's dominant political leader until 1989. His formal party title changed from First Secretary to General Secretary, and from 1976 he additionally chaired the State Council. ATLAS follows the established Brezhnev/Khrushchev normalization and records one continuous top-party leadership Activity rather than splitting a continuous de facto leadership tenure solely because the office title changed.

sources.title: Erich Honecker — LeMO, Haus der Geschichte
sources.citation_text: Haus der Geschichte identifies Honecker as SED First Secretary from 1971 to 1989 and notes that from 1976 he also chaired the State Council, holding the highest party and state offices.
